comment: Hand-written materials fragment for the tree-import example. Instead of cooking a new KTX2 texture (trackg_cook.py textures, which needs ktx.exe), this mod REUSES the stock oak1 leaf texture that already ships in the game install: data/tgl/128/a_oak1.ktx2 (+ data/tgl/128/a_oak1.tga, confirmed 128x128 RGBA with an alpha channel). textureName MUST match the texture image name inside the GLB ('a_oak1.png' -> engine derives 'a_oak1.tga'). The 'a_' prefix means alpha-tested and must agree with alphaClass=1 / flags.alpha_test=true (validator rule A6).
